inj.note: Brown was unable play against the Bears in Week 7 due to a knee injury. He faded an injury tag for Sunday's game after logging a full practice Friday, and he should reclaim his starting spot at right guard.

news.h: Patriots' Alijah Vera-Tucker, Ben Brown ruled out vs. Bears
news.d: The Patriots will be without starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown for Thursday's game against the Bears due to injuries, coach Mike Vrabel said.
